title: Filter an unsolicited sales pitch
instruction: Is this email unsolicited spam or bulk marketing?

state.subject: Exclusive deal for business owners
state.body: Dear business owner, buy our premium office software today at 85% off! This limited offer is sent to thousands of companies. Click now and claim your discount before midnight.

criteria.description: The email is unsolicited spam or bulk marketing.
The email is not unsolicited spam or bulk marketing.

criteria.description: The email is unsolicited spam or bulk marketing.
The email is not unsolicited spam or bulk marketing.

title: Check whether an expense needs a receipt
instruction: Is the statement supported by the policy?

state.policy: Employees must attach a receipt to every expense claim. Claims without receipts are rejected.
state.statement: Employees must submit receipts with expense claims.

criteria.description: The policy supports the statement.
The policy contradicts the statement.

title: Same people, opposite money transfer
instruction: Do the sentences express the same meaning, including who did what to whom?

state.sentence1: Nina transferred thirty dollars to Owen.
state.sentence2: Owen transferred thirty dollars to Nina.

criteria.description: The two sentences express the same meaning.
The two sentences do not express the same meaning.

The two sentences do not express the same meaning.

title: A claim contradicted by a short passage

The premise guarantees that the claim is false.

title: Unrelated account information
instruction: Evaluate the document for the query using only their supplied text. A complete answer directly provides the requested information; unrelated text provides no useful evidence.
